summary: Spotify requires a Premium account to use the Web API. Apps begin in development mode with restricted user access, requiring an allowlist. Moving to extended quota mode for public access requires meeting strict business and user base criteria, with a review process taking up to six weeks.

If your app makes a lot of Web API requests in a short period of time then it

blockers.issue: Never reveal your client secret key publicly.

extras.title: HTTPS requirement
extras.why_it_matters: Required for all redirect URIs except loopback addresses.

claims.text: Redirect URIs must use HTTPS unless using a loopback address.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: Use HTTPS for your redirect URI, unless you are using a loopback address, when HTTP is permitted.

claims.text: The authorization code flow is recommended for long-running server-side applications that can safely store a client secret.
claims.label: official_docs
claims.evidence_quote: If you are developing a long-running application (e.g. web app running on the server) that can refresh access tokens and request user authorization again when needed, and the client secret can be safely stored, then the authorization code flow is the recommended choice.
